description: A React component for an invitation modal in Mattermost, handling user/channel invitations, search, and UI states.

classes.name: InvitationModal
classes.description: A React component class for managing the invitation modal UI, including invite and result views, search, and user interactions.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show state to false.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Handles modal exit, focusing the origin element and calling onExited callback.

methods.name: toggleCustomMessage
methods.description: Toggles the custom message input open/closed.

methods.name: setInviteAs
methods.description: Sets the invite type (member or guest).

methods.name: toggleGuestMagicLink
methods.description: Toggles the use of guest magic link.

methods.name: invite
methods.description: Performs the invite action based on current state and props, updates view to result.

methods.name: inviteMore
methods.description: Resets the view to invite for additional invitations.

methods.name: channelsLoader
methods.description: Loads and filters channels based on search term and invite type.

methods.name: usersLoader
methods.description: Loads user profiles based on search term with debounce.

methods.name: onChangeUsersEmails
methods.description: Updates state with selected users or emails.

methods.name: getBackdrop
methods.description: Determines modal backdrop behavior based on current state and permissions.
